title: Grand Depths+
description: A total conversion survival-adventure experience in a complete new dimension with unique mechanics and progression.
body:
**Grand Depths+** is the intended way to play [Grand Depths](https://modrinth.com/mod/grand_depths), with a few gameplay and balance changes, QOL, cosmetic and optimization mods to provide a better experience.

[Grand Depths](https://modrinth.com/mod/grand_depths) is a total conversion survival-adventure mod that takes place in a new dimension without any vanilla items (besides a few necessary exceptions).
Here's a list of some current features from the mod:![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c9a5d8112f6c5d837eb04f9b851a0f5ac567b35.png)

**Check out [Grand Depths](https://modrinth.com/mod/grand_depths) by [LIK87](https://modrinth.com/user/LIK87) and give him some honest feedback on the mod! Do keep in mind that the mod is currently in it's early stage of development so many changes and additions are planned in the future!**
